caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a cylindrical body, a long, narrow spout extending to the left, and a curved handle to the right, both of which are attached near the top edge of the pot. The teapot features a decorative pattern with a floral garland and a central medallion containing a letter or symbol on its side. The lid, which fits snugly on top, is topped with a small, ornate finial. The drawing is primarily executed in shades of gray and black, characteristic of graphite or pencil sketches, with shading to indicate reflections and three-dimensionality. The background is plain, with the drawing framed by a rectangular outline, and the paper shows several orange-brown stains at the corners and edges. In the bottom right corner, detailed notations read: "TEAPOT CASF2. 8519.5 INCHES X 7" and "H. BADER," indicating measurements and the artist's signature.
title: Silver Teapot
